references.text: The same offering regulations for the burnt offering on the new moon day: two young bulls, one ram, and seven year-old lambs.
Similar burnt offering regulations for the first day of the seventh month with the same number of animals.
Burnt offerings on the Day of Atonement with the same sacrificial composition: one bull, one ram, and seven year-old lambs.
Regulations for the Feast of Weeks (Shavuot) that include burnt offerings with lambs, bulls, and rams.
The burnt offering is described as 'a pleasing aroma to the Lord' (ריח ניחח ליהוה), the same expression found in Numbers 28:27.
Basic description of the burnt offering as 'a pleasing aroma to the Lord'.
First occurrence of the term 'pleasing aroma' (ריח ניחח) in connection with an offering to the Lord.
